messages:
elaine: Quick thread to align on DP cohort segmentation and the stoplight gating we promised the execs. Need a crisp, transparent rubric we can publish to partners.

sophie: Good call. I propose a three-tier gating: GREEN (full access, telemetry ok), AMBER (limited observability, manual check-ins), RED (no telemetry or high compliance risk).

elainE: typo = elaine. For green -> require: telemetry consent, 2x eng contacts, tokens/day >50k OR long-context baseline, and start window <=2 wks.

raj: From runtime: green gets "dp_canary" lane + auto-batching; amber gets rate-limited trials with sampling; red gets onboarding hold. Also request: tag each session with dp_gate={green,amber,red}.

maria: For amber, partners that decline full telemetry should still be able to join with synthetic baselines & manual logs, but we need a strict data handling note.

ana: @ana here. Compliance check: any partner with regulated PHI/PII must be red until legal signoff. Add a mandatory intake field: "sends_protected_data": yes/no.

ben: Ops metrics to expose for green cohorts: p50/p95 latency, tokens/request, cost/1k, error_rate, kv_cache_hit. For amber we only show aggregated weekly deltas.

elaine: Success criteria idea: two gates. Launch gate = operational safety (no >2% error regression, p95 within SLA). Outcome gate = product impact (partner-reported UX stable + measurable cost or latency improvement on canonical flow).

sophie: Make the outcome gate binary for partner communications: pass/fail/partial with examples. Partial = improvements but not yet deployable.

raj: Technical rollback policy: auto-fallback if error rate >=1.5x baseline for 15min OR p95 regresses >30% for 10min. Platform-bot should auto-notify #incidents and tag oncall.

legal-bot: NDA template dp-basic-v3 referenced. Partners with amber status must still sign telemetry consent for sampled logs; opt-outs go to red. Typical legal turnaround 48h.

elaine: Owners: Sophie = intake + partner comms; Raj = runtime tags & routing; Ben = dashboard templates; Ana = legal escalations. We'll publish the stoplight doc and scoring sheet.

maria: Recruitment tie-breakers: earlier start date, higher tokens/day, and willingness to be a reference. We'll surface selection transparency.

elaine: OK team  I'll draft the public-facing gating one-pager and drop the intake link here tomorrow. If anyone has objections to the amber workflow, raise now. :white_check_mark:
